newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo bank names Maranzana new MD.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo bank names Maranzana new MD.

text.p: Italy's biggest bank Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino SpA said it has appointed Luigi Maranzana as its new managing director.
Former managing director Dario Pasqua announced he was leaving his post at last week's annual shareholders' meeting of the bank whose privatisation is to take place later this month.

San Paolo is going ahead on May 19 with a public share offer of 25 percent of the bank's stock after privately placing some 20 percent with friendly banks and financial institutions who together will form a core of stable shareholders.
Pasqua had given no reasons for his resignation.
The bank said in a statement that Maranzana, who joined the bank in 1961, would for the time being also retain his post as Director General of the company, a post he has occupied since 1995.
The bank's board, meeting on Monday for the first time since the April 30 AGM, also said it had named a new executive committee, increasing the members to nine from six.
Members by right were San Paolo Chairman Gianni Zandano, deputy chairman Emilio Ottolenghi and managing director Luigi Maranzana, the statement said.

The six elected members were Renato Tullio Ferrari and Gabriele Galateri from Agneli family holdings (IFI and IFIL, Divo Gronchi from Italian bank Monte dei Paschi di Siena, Juan R.Inciarte of Spain's Banco Santander, Rainer Masera from Italy's IMI bank and Iti Mihalich from Italian insurer Reale Mutuale.
